MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 7
   C. 3
   D. 6

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 7

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 16

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 40

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

16. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

17. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

18. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
